title: Contents Packout & Storage Floor Runner Charge at Furniture Reset
content:
Floor runners are laid under every piece set on newly finished floors during a Contents Packout & Storage furniture reset, the lead being the calendar days from the substantial completion date of the company rebuild contract read at the job's loss address to the job's returned date: **when that lead is zero or more and no more than the reset fresh-finish days, each piece set carries the fresh-finish runner charge; when it is more than the reset fresh-finish days, each piece set carries the settled-finish runner charge; when no substantial completion date is recorded on the contract read, or the completion date falls after the returned date, no runner charge applies.**

The company rebuild contract read at the job's loss address is the one at that address on the job's own claim file, or with no claim file when the job has none, and among those the one furthest along, taking a closed contract first, then a final invoiced, substantially complete, in construction, permitted, signed and proposed one in that order; a cancelled contract is never read; the company keeps one rebuild contract per claim file and address, added scope for the same claim and address being written as a change order on it, so no two contracts share that place in the order.

| Lead from the Reconstruction contract's substantial completion date to the returned date | Runner charge per piece set |
|---|---|
| 0 to 30 days (no more than the reset fresh-finish days) | 2.10 |
| more than 30 days | 1.05 |
| no completion date recorded on the contract read, or completion after the return | none |

**Boundary cases (abstract dates).** Lead of 30 days: 2.10 per piece. Lead of 31 days: 1.05 per piece. Completion recorded after the returned date: none.
